reviews.text: I really enjoy using this app, which (as the name suggests) focuses very much on speaking the language and engagement with the learner, rather than how far and how quickly you can get up league tables (I eventually scrapped that one). The Speak app's "listening" seems to me to be very accurate too. I still keep Spanish Dict on my phone as that one is very good for grammar, and quick word and phrase look-ups, but Speak has become my go-to in a purely learning context. Five-star so far!

What I love about this that it is really basic which is exactly what I need! also there is a fair amount of repetition (plus one can repeat a sentence as many times as you like) which, again is what I need. Also love that can complete in 5 minute chunks so so have complete control over your own learning including the time you can spare. Possibly wpuld prefer if it was European rather than Latin American Spanish.

The experience is very interactive and gives a crisp hearing of the pronunciation. The option to slow down the spreed of the voice helps to catch every word. As well to better pronounce and knowing where to roll the R's. When given practice to speak in a conversation with AI saying it in English, makes me recall how to say it in Spanish. I just downloaded it and I find it very interactive! It makes learning another language fun and exciting! I would recommend this application for sure!

I've been using Duolingo for several years, just trying to keep up my language skills. Sadly, the region of the language it uses isn't the region I speak or am interested in learning...but I've stuck with it for 1930 days. It's been helpful, but this app was really cool in that I can skip ahead easily and find things that are more helpful or applicable to my learning level. I can't do that in Duolingo...sadly. This app also targeted the region of the language I speak and it was really cool!
